## 8. Mimimi–Tama: current directions and serious alternatives

| Field | Mimimi → Tama | Tama → Mimimi | Boundary through V12 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Desired relation | Chosen close company, humor, widened participation and a tie she trusts to continue. | Particular close friendship, shared company and care for the person she calls her hero. | No mandatory exclusivity, romantic category or future replacement is established. |
| Standing | Familiar friend, former social bridge, expressive model and received beneficiary of recognition. | Familiar friend, direct recognizer, learner by choice and source of ordinary care. | Each role matters without owning the other person's entire support system. |
| Knowledge | Knows Tama's direct style, some preferences, class pain and widening reach; reader receives her own role-loss and separation worries. | Notices particular feeling and atmosphere, remembers shrimp dislike, asks about the café discussion. | Tama is not shown hearing the V12 separation question; neither receives every private focalization. |
| Disclosure | Can conceal accommodation, later report her love conversation and voice doubts to others. | Can conceal food work, ask for an account and disclose weight/warmth. | Concealed care is real but makes recognition and negotiation incomplete. |
| Trust | Values Tama's particular judgment and does not expect abrupt abandonment. | Can try a revised short outing with Mimimi and take a heavy question seriously. | Trust in the bond differs from guaranteed physical proximity or lifelong emotional stability. |
| Leverage | Brightness, practical mediation and known care can shape Tama's options; her pain partly motivates training. | Her irreplaceable recognition can alter Mimimi's self-valuation. | Neither influence is a general instruction or proof of deliberate coercion. |
| Care | Makes openings, stays near, models expression and gives up one wanted format without announcing it. | Gives recognition, remembers food, receives disclosure and chooses timing. | Different acts and costs are not an equalized sacrifice ledger. |
| Dependency | Can fear loss of usefulness and later question self-liking under separation while welcoming growth. | Receives real help yet develops other relations, craft and methods of refusal. | No one-way dependence, self-sufficiency cure or promise of limitless capacity. |
| Ordinary presence | Enjoys teasing, food, outings, response and participation with others. | Enjoys company, appetite, reciprocal food and selective new activity. | Ordinary pleasure does not require every joke or touch to be welcome. |
| Boundaries/refusal | Revises the larger outing to a brief dyadic trial; continued care does not claim the whole timetable. | Evades a grasp, leaves for her own reason, declines karaoke formats, revises a tired joke and waits outside privacy. | Agreement to one experiment is not a completed outcome or future standing permission. |
| Conflict/repair | Gladness outweighs reduced-need sadness in the shown group scene; no sabotage is depicted. | Objects to inattention, grasping or food-taking while receiving ordinary exchange and company. | No equivalent new severe dyadic disagreement or tested long-term cost protocol is shown. |
| Third parties | Kana/Sakura/Yuki, Fumiya, Hinami and the mother widen available practices without replacing the bond. | Family, customers, staff and other friends give ends independent of sustaining Mimimi. | Outsiders have their own acts; they are not a single rival audience or interchangeable helpers. |
| Consent/authority | Owns the kindness she chooses and her later self-question, not Tama's preferences or future availability. | Owns learning, work, boundaries and the scope of what she offers, not Mimimi's whole worth or love. | Received benefit, familiar access and accurate concern do not pool authority. |

Several rivals have real evidence but fail as total accounts. **Tama is only dependent** notices Mimimi's early bridge work and misses the hero statement, food adjustment, waiting and recipient-side insight. **Mimimi wants her dependent** notices role-loss sadness and misses explicit greater joy in Tama's expanded company. **Relational firstness cures rank once and for all** preserves the V02 success but cannot explain the later running story or direct V12 question. **The relation is unhealthy because value is received from another person** notices vulnerability but cannot explain the warmth, particularity and freely wanted practices without making all attachment suspect. **The girls are so close that permission is unnecessary** erases actual refusals and uneven knowledge. **V12 requires a replacement or complete independence** supplies a future the speakers do not select. [EP-C04–10]

The stronger account preserves the initial rescue, the reciprocity, the joy of widening and the incompletion. Their importance is not disproved when neither can be the other's entire answer. It is made more specific. The relation has earned coequal treatment because it changes both persons' possible actions, carries its own ordinary pleasures and supports a longitudinal problem no single trait or crisis can contain.
